Amit Shah announces green cover increase and library inauguration

Union Home Minister Amit Shah has announced plans to increase Gandhinagar's green cover by 20% by 2029 as part of the 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' campaign. He also inaugurated the Jayaprakash Narayan library in Delhi, stating that crowded libraries are an indicator of a nation's future. Additionally, he launched a 'Mission 5 Million Trees Campaign' in Ahmedabad.
